title: Fix Jinshu 053 source mentions and require person references before publication
body:
Jinshu 053’s first live check exposed a named father, Wei Guan, whose name was consumed by his son’s compound mention. His profile therefore had no inverse source excerpts even though extraction, qualification and CI passed. Give Wei Guan his own Chinese/English spans, narrow his son’s spans, and reject scoped person publication with no source mention references. Preserve the complete name claims, aliases, translations, chronology and canonical assignments.

The original independent date reviewer freshly approved all 209 units/206 date items/73 people on the repaired extraction. The original independent identity reviewer freshly adopted the exact current 72-case report covering 73 records, retaining 63 explicit uncertainties. Their earlier proofs and reports remain preserved; the old date report is archived using the normal history naming convention. The named-parent regression and the existing scoped projection fixtures pass locally. The new guard has a separate independent code review.

This also includes the independently reviewed verifier speed improvement: skip Cheerio parsing when the literal person-link attribute is absent; preserve the original DOM predicate whenever it may be present. Adversarial DOM comparison and out-of-scope uppercase-anchor regressions pass. Previous CI measured the verifier phase at 3m48s versus 7m14s; this is not proof of one-hour chapter throughput.

Required CI must requalify the real nonempty chapter and its ebook contribution on the new inputs. Completion still requires production deployment and exact live chapter/profile, inverse snippet, uncertainty, search, sitemap, redirect and image checks. The failed first live receipt is preserved, and this PR alone is not a live-completion claim.
